requirements.text: The DASG Architecture Lab and Customer Enablement Lab (CEL) teams provide the infrastructure, platforms, and technical expertise required to accelerate technology pathfinding, AI and system workload analysis, memory subsystem characterization, FPGA/LPDRAM prototyping, and customer enablement initiatives. These teams play a critical role in enabling architecture exploration, validation, and teamwork across engineering organizations and external partners. AI Efficiency and Usage is a must. AI proficiency or AI‑enabled ways of working where applicable. Agentic AI and Generative AI usage model is a must.
Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
5+ years of experience in server architecture, system-level validation, platform bring-up, hardware/software debug, or engineering lab infrastructure operations.
Demonstrated ability configuring and maintaining validation platforms, test equipment, protocol analyzers, power analyzers, oscilloscopes, environmental chambers, or similar laboratory assets.
Proven experience developing automation solutions using Python, Shell, or similar scripting languages.
Experience with BIOS, BMC, firmware, operating systems, device drivers, networking, storage, power delivery, and thermal management concepts in lab environments.
Master's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
Experience working with DRAM, LPDDR, HBM, CXL, memory subsystem architecture, or memory validation workflows.
2+ years of experience supporting AI, machine learning, HPC workloads, GPU platforms, or performance characterization activities.
Experience with CUDA, ROCm, DRAMSim3, Ramulator2, trace capture/replay methodologies, or related modeling and analysis tools.
Experience supporting FPGA platforms, hardware prototyping environments, protocol debugging, multi-site laboratory operations, or equipment lifecycle management.
